mission: Sales-Centric Product Cross-Selling, Same-Shop Multi-Item Inventory Matching, and Quality-Tier Ranking (SCPQ)
problem_statement: Shift Torob conversational suggestions from defensive procedural questions to high-conversion product sales (cases, glass, chargers, consumables). Implement multi-item same-shop inventory detection (whether the seller has the companion in stock) and objective quality-tier ranking (which shop has the genuine, superior warranty product).

roles.name: Commercial Retail & Merchandising Strategist (CRMS)
roles.responsibility: Formulate high-conversion product cross-sell suggestions (accessories, consumables, bundle add-ons) aligned with customer purchase psychology.

roles.name: Multi-Item Inventory & Graph Matcher (MIIGM)
roles.responsibility: Design and implement Same-Shop Inventory Matching (SSIM) to identify whether the active store carries the companion items for single-stop shopping.

roles.name: Quality & Authenticity Scoring Architect (QASA)
roles.responsibility: Formalize the Shop Quality & Authenticity Scoring Algorithm (SQAS) across warranty tiers, verification, and authenticity flags to determine 'کدوم مغازه جنس بهتر داره'.

roles.name: Conversational UI & NLU Integration Engineer (CUIIE)
roles.responsibility: Integrate sales-centric prompt chips and rich badges ('موجود در همین مغازه', 'جنس برتر و اورجینال') into frontend bubbles and backend NLU search/consultation handlers.

roles.name: Verification & Red-Team Tester (VRTT)
roles.responsibility: Write automated unit tests and execute live browser verifications across phones, samovars, drills, and laptops.

deliverables: public/app.js & public/app.css (Rich badges and UI rendering)
